newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP says Buffalo One flows 11,790 bpd. [CORRECTED 01:24 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP says Buffalo One flows 11,790 bpd. [CORRECTED 01:24 GMT]

text.p: Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Monday that the Buffalo One exploration well in the Timor Sea flowed 11,790 barrels of oil per day and 328,000 cubic feet of gas. (Corrects gas flow from 328 million cubic feet to 328,000 cubic feet.)
The well is in permit WA-260-P, the same permit as the Laminaria East oil disovery, and wholly-owned by BHP.

It said the flow of 53 degree API oil and the gas was through a 52/64 inch choke over the interval 3307 metres to 3335 metres. Buffalo One had been plugged and abandoned, with further evaluation work to be undertaken, BHP said.
